crypto.random: Python secrets/os.urandom backed by operating-system CSPRNG

windows_secure_storage.secret_file_acl: current user + SYSTEM full control; inherited broad ACEs removed

database_encryption.build_policy: SOMA CI builds/tests pinned Windows x64 wheels from sqlcipher3 binding source plus official SQLCipher 4.17.0 amalgamation; exact source commits/digests freeze in dependency lock; no runtime download
database_encryption.keying: 32-byte random live DEK passed as SQLCipher raw key BLOB; never password/passphrase
database_encryption.cipher_profile: AES-256-CBC page encryption + per-page HMAC-SHA512 integrity; page size 4096; cipher_use_hmac ON; cipher_plaintext_header_size 0; cipher_memory_security ON
database_encryption.verification: after raw key and before schema/migration operation verify cipher_version=4.17.0, provider/version, expected cipher settings and SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master; any mismatch blocks authoritative connection

packaging.tray: SOMA-owned ctypes Win32 Shell_NotifyIconW + hidden message window; no tray framework dependency
packaging.browser_launch: ShellExecuteW canonical verified loopback origin; Edge/Chrome supported acceptance matrix; no bundled WebView2/browser
packaging.runtime_network: no runtime dependency/download; installer may contain only prebuilt verified artifacts

dependency_policy: all build/runtime dependencies are pinned/hash-locked in release metadata; application never invokes pip/npm/winget/browser download at runtime
